description: This file is a shell script used for testing git commands, specifically the 'show-ref' command, verifying its output under various conditions.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit, optionally with annotation, for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that should succeed, with setup commands and assertions.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the specified command fails.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks if a command exits with a specific code.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the test finishes.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a file.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Asserts that the specified input is empty.
